sections.Profile:
"Torch" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1980 as part of the Gottlieb System 1 series. The game features a sports theme with two flippers, no ramps, and does not have a multiball mode. Designed by John Buras with artwork by Gordon Morison, it has a production run of 3,880 units.
